purpose: Original desktop wallpapers matching the approved game design mockups

photos.prompt: Extract and reconstruct only the wallpaper from the reference. Remove all interface, windows, icons, captions and branding. Seamlessly reconstruct the background behind them, preserving its colors and composition. soft luminous blue folded ribbons and curved glassy wave forms. Output only an original edge-to-edge landscape wallpaper, no text, no interface.
photos.encoding: JPEG optimized for the game, original generated artwork preserved separately
